name: Circle of the Sky (Druid Circle)
body:
You are one with the winds and charged storms that circle the skies. You bring the wrath of the skies to bear on those below.

Bonus Spells: obscuring mist (1st), wind wall (2nd), call lightning (3rd), river of wind (4th), call lightning storm (5th). control winds (6th), control weather (7th), whirlwind (8th), winds of vengeance (9th).

Manifestation: You are constantly charged with static electricity and your hair seems to always be shifting in the wind even when there is none. Your hair and eye color tends to be in the shades of storm clouds or the wide blue sky.

Granted Powers: You gain the following abilities as part of this circle.

Borne Aloft (Sp)

At 1st level, you may cast feather fall or levitate on yourself at-will without using a spell slot. At 8th level you can cast fly on yourself at-will without using a spell slot.

At 16th level, your levitate and fly spells last 1 hour per level instead of 1 minute per level.

Stormborn (Su)

At 8th level, you continually surround yourself with a swirling wind that grants you a 25% miss chance versus any ranged projectile that weighs less than 25 pounds. At 16th level, this miss chance increases to 50%.

Prevailing Wind (Su)

At 16th level, you can generate powerful and subtle winds in any environment where air is present.

You can create and control a sustained wind that can move an object of up to 300 lbs, or creature up to Large size up to 30 feet per round in any direction, unless the creature makes a successful Reflex save versus a DC of 10 + half your class level + your Wisdom modifier. The effect lasts for as long as you concentrate on it (a standard action each round). The object or creature must remain within 120 feet of you. You can turn and move the object, but cannot perform tasks that require manual dexterity.

You can also use your wind to blast creatures directly. You can attempt to harm a creature. The creature must make a Reflex save (as above) or take 1d6 bludgeoning damage per class level. Alternatively, you can attempt to knock down a creature. The creature must make a Fortitude saving throw or be pushed up to 30 feet and knocked prone. Either effect can be used at a range of up to 120 feet.

Druidic talents

The following talents are available to legendary druids with this circle:

Fully Charged (Ex)

(Major Talent)

You gain electricity resistance equal to twice your class level.

At 16th level, this becomes electricity immunity.

Kept Aloft (Ex)

(Minor Talent)

When you fly by any means, you gain a +30-foot enhancement bonus to your fly speed and your maneuverability becomes perfect.

Stormsight (Ex)

(Minor Talent)

Your vision is no longer hampered by fog, smoke, vapor, or precipitation. You do not suffer any Perception penalties or concealment caused by such effects, whether natural or otherwise. Other creatures targeting or attempting Perception still suffer the effects.

Thunderous (Ex)

(Major Talent)

You are immune to the deafened or stunned conditions from air, sonic or electricity effects.
